name: sources-registry
what: Curate where kama learns: tier-scoped, revision-anchored rows; contract-v1 census clean

name: ollama-offline-evidence-replay
what: Reconcile caller-supplied `/api/tags` + `/api/ps` captures fail-closed; readiness always unknown

name: live-llamacpp-lifecycle
what: Start the pinned llama.cpp b11755 server on an unregistered loopback port, capture its loading and ready surfaces, grade and tear it down

name: gguf-declared-identity-replay
what: Decode bounded local GGUF metadata offline and compare declared metadata with a captured receipt

name: context-capacity-receipt
what: Run the registered context-capacity cells on the lane-owned llama.cpp fixture and write a sha256-bound receipt

name: instrument-agreement
what: Run a lane instrument N times over one tree and emit a receipt with per-run digests and an agreement counter

name: pin-watch
what: List upstream release tags for each pinned serving engine (SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp) and report, per pin, the newest release tag and how many releases sort above it; exit 1 flags a recheck trigger

name: digest-ledger
what: Find every full SHA-256 the lane's documents cite and classify it: a committed blob, a ledger-declared external artifact re-hashed on this host, an unverifiable digest with its reason, or a flagged known-wrong digest; exit 1 on any unexplained digest

name: hexrun-census
what: Find every lower-case hex run of 32-127 characters other than 64 that the lane's documents cite (git object ids, MD5 sums, over-long or abbreviated runs) and classify it: a lane object, the MD5 of a committed blob, an upstream object whose committed evidence file contains it, an unverifiable run with its reason, or a flagged wrong run linked to a correct one; exit 1 on any unexplained run

name: live-receipt-replay
what: Re-acquire a `kama-llamacpp-live/v5` receipt's server release archive and model from the https URLs its provenance block records - the model pinned to a 40-hex `/resolve/<commit>/` revision that the receipt also states as `provenance.model.commit` - verify both sha256 values before anything is extracted or executed, check the archive and its member against the asset and server digests before the server starts so a v5 receipt's `provenance.verified` block is recorded rather than asserted, re-run the lifecycle from an empty home passing the downloaded archive as `--server-archive`, hold the rerun server up for an outside observer on request (`--witness-dir`: `ready.json` names the port and the server child's pid, the server stays up until `release` or the bounded timeout, and the rerun receipt records `witness.released`), refuse a server-archive member that is sparse or whose declared size differs from the `--server` file before hashing it, compare the rerun with the original past check pass/fail on a stable projection of the captured surfaces (props fields, slots count and body digest, health status and body digest, models ids and owned_by, metrics status, loading envelope, teardown outcome, listener ownership), refuse a receipt whose provenance is missing or unverified, whose recorded digest does not match what it downloads, or whose server-archive member is unsafe, and answer `--compare A B` on two receipts without the network
